title: 36 Hours in Gothenburg, Sweden
abstract: Visitors to Sweden’s second-largest city will find homegrown fashion labels, craft beer bars, a lively arts scene and even a “Fish Church.”

title: 36 Hours in Siena, Italy
abstract: Country collides with city in this Tuscan town, where things haven’t changed much in 800 years.

title: 36 Hours in Modena, Italy
abstract: Sensory pleasures are abundant in this city north of Florence, where food is drizzled with transcendent vinegar and a new museum honors the founder of Ferrari.

title: 36 Hours in New Haven, Conn.
abstract: Go birding before a flight of beers and shop vintage before driving for a view on a weekend trip to this Ivy League town.
